SK_Duck_Headless.body_boxes_note: Trunk AABB only (no head); 1 cm padding, actor-forward UE cm.
SK_Duck_Headless.notes: Same 23-bone hierarchy and bind pose as SK_Duck (one source armature). Import with the SK_Duck Skeleton so every Duck clip plays on it. Wound cap and blood runs use MI_Duck_Feather (opacity mask).

SM_Duck_Head.collision: UCX_SM_Duck_Head_LOD0_01 (single convex hull, in the LOD0 FBX)
SM_Duck_Head.material_note: Eye faces use MI_Duck_Feather on the prop (2-slot prop_small budget); gloss comes from the ORM roughness.
SM_Duck_Head.pivot: base centre of the head-with-stub at rest
SM_Duck_Head.physics: Simulate physics on the UCX hull; suggested mass 0.12 kg, linear damping 0.6, angular damping 0.4.

blood_pool.notes: Deferred decal, BC alpha = opacity; wet roughness in ORM.G.

blood_spatter.notes: Random drip decal for the headless run (original random_blood seq 187-189).

original_behaviour.source: source/dink/dink.cpp duck_brain (D:12723) and one_time_brain (D:15741); dink.ini seq 111-129
first_hit: draw_damage, add_exp, kill script (die/die5 sets editor_type 6 so the duck stays dead)
spawn the head: brain 5 one-shot, seq 121-129 (4 frames x 125 ms = 0.5 s), moving in the duck direction at speed 1-3, then frozen into the background as a head in a pool of blood
body switches to base_walk 110 (bloody headless walk, 4 frames x 75 ms loop = 0.3 s), speed 1, keeps wandering like a live duck
while headless: 1 % chance per think to drop a random blood splat (seq 187-189)
second_hit: magic flash effect seq 164 at the body, add_exp, check_for_duck_script (duckdie), the body is removed at once
remaster_wiring: On first hit: swap the component mesh SK_Duck -> SK_Duck_Headless (same skeleton), play HeadlessRun at the brain speed.
Spawn SM_Duck_Head at the neck_03 bone transform with a small impulse along the duck heading (original speed 1-3) plus spin; when it settles, place the blood_pool decal under it.
While headless, 1 % per think: blood_spatter decal at the body.
On second hit: either the faithful instant removal with the seq-164 flash, or play HeadlessDeath (1.6 s, hold last frame) and then remove; keep the original exp/script timing either way.
Non-gory alternatives remain available: Hit and Death on the intact SK_Duck.

tone: Darkly comic, not horror: the body keeps strutting and flapping as if nothing happened; blood is bright and wet, not lingered on.
